channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Sydney School Inquiry: Students Shared Beds with Teachers
item.description: An inquiry in New South Wales heard that students at Redeemer Baptist School, a private religious institution in Sydney, were made to share beds with teachers. A former student testified that while nothing untoward happened to her… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Russell Brand faces sexual assault trial in London court
item.description: Comedian and actor Russell Brand appeared in court on Monday for the first day of his sexual assault trial. He has pleaded not guilty to all charges. The trial is taking place in London. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Two separate incidents report deaths of young men in India
item.description: In Janjgir-Champa, Chhattisgarh, a car overturned near a drain after becoming uncontrollable, resulting in the on-the-spot death of a young man who had reportedly purchased the vehicle one to two days prior. In Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: ED Raids Eight Locations in Kolkata Over Multi-Crore Fraud
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) conducted raids at eight locations in Kolkata, West Bengal, in connection with a multi-crore fraud case. The operation aimed to uncover the trail of funds allegedly siphoned off through fraudulent… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: JNU Professor-MP FIR, BJP Protest Over Allegations
item.description: Delhi Police have registered a First Information Report (FIR) against Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) professor and Member of Parliament Angomcha Bimol Akoijam, based on a complaint by the university's Chief Security Officer. The FIR… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Noida Schools Receive Bomb Threats, Investigations Underway
item.description: Multiple schools in Noida, including APJ, Step By Step, DPS GBN, JP, and Amity, received bomb threats, causing panic. Police and dog squads responded to the locations. Investigations into the calls, suspected to be hoaxes, have been… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan Expresses Anger Over Demolition of Tribal Homes
item.description: In Kosmi village, Budhni, Sehore district, Madhya Pradesh, Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan expressed anger towards his own government after tribal families' homes were demolished and crops destroyed. The action, carried out by the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Noida Woman Attacked by Unmuzzled Dog, Her Pet Killed
item.description: In Noida, a woman was attacked by an unmuzzled pet dog, which also killed her pet. The incident occurred in Noida. A video of the attack has been circulated. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Thieves Loot SBI ATM Using Ambulance, Caught on CCTV
item.description: Thieves wearing nightgowns broke into an SBI ATM early in the morning and stole cash, loading it into an ambulance. The incident was captured on CCTV footage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Saudi Airport Attacks Prompt Travel Warnings
item.description: Seven countries have issued travel warnings following attacks on a Saudi airport. One opinion piece suggests these attacks highlight Pakistan's overreach in its role as a mediator. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Restrains CBI Action Against Punjab CM Aide
item.description: The Supreme Court has ordered that no coercive action be taken against Rajbir Singh Ghuman, an Officer on Special Duty (OSD) linked to the Punjab government and Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann, in a corruption case being investigated by the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Clarifies Stance on New Form 6 in Bihar SIR Case
item.description: The Supreme Court has clarified its position on the new Form 6, stating that it has neither approved nor disapproved of the changes. These alterations, introduced in July, require applicants to provide ancestry details or linkage to… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Dozens of gold miners killed in airstrikes on Sudan-Egypt border
item.description: At least 72 people were killed and 28 injured in airstrikes on an artisanal gold mining camp in a disputed border area between Sudan and Egypt on Saturday. The Sudan Doctors Network and the Emergency Lawyers organization reported the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 1.

item.title: UK Mayor Condemns US Firing Squad Execution Livestream Plan
item.description: Andy Burnham, Mayor of Greater Manchester, has described the planned livestream of a firing squad execution in the United States as 'abhorrent'. His comments were made in response to the US moving forward with the execution, a plan… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court to hear petition on activist detentions and contempt claims
item.description: The youth wing of the Communist Party of India (Marxist) (DYFI) has filed a petition in the Supreme Court seeking an inquiry into alleged illegal detention and torture of its activists during a demonstration, and requesting guidelines on… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: North Korea Fires Multiple Ballistic Missiles Off East Coast
item.description: North Korea launched multiple ballistic missiles toward its east coast on Monday, according to South Korea's military. The launches have heightened tensions on the Korean Peninsula. This event follows a recent incident last month where… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 9 · Right 2.

item.title: India Condemns Hormuz Vessel Attacks, Two Indian Seafarers Missing
item.description: Two commercial vessels carrying Indian seafarers were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz and Oman. India has condemned the strikes, with the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) calling for an end to such attacks and de-escalation. Two Indian… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 2.

item.title: Supreme Court hears contempt pleas over Delhi protest clampdown
item.description: The Supreme Court indicated it sees grounds for contempt proceedings in a plea concerning actions taken during Delhi protests. The court issued a notice to authorities after finding a 'prima facie case' in the contempt plea related to the… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 15 · Right 4.

item.title: Three Killed in Kochi After Mini Cooper Rams Scooter
item.description: Three 21-year-old individuals, identified as Devika, Gopika, and Ijaz, were killed when a Mini Cooper car collided with their scooter near Kochi airport in Ernakulam district. The deceased were part-time salespersons returning to duty. The… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 7 · Right 2.

item.title: BLA Attacks Pakistani Coast Guard in Gwadar, Balochistan
item.description: The Baloch Liberation Army (BLA) launched a significant attack in Gwadar, Balochistan, resulting in the deaths of 13 personnel from the Pakistani Coast Guard. The incident occurred in Gwadar. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 3.

item.title: ICE Agent Hits Man During Chase in Texas
item.description: An Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agent in Texas struck a man with a vehicle on Saturday during a pursuit in the Houston area. The man, identified as Parra-Hernandez, sustained a suspected broken leg and was taken to a hospital… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump to decide on livestreaming Fort Hood shooter's execution
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has stated he will decide whether to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan, the Fort Hood shooter. Hasan was convicted of killing 13 people and wounding 32 others in a 2009 shooting at Fort Hood, Texas. The… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Naga group issues 48-hour ultimatum for return of severed head amid Manipur violence
item.description: On October 10, 2026 a video showing a severed head among heavily armed militants circulated online; the headless body of Ajinbou R was taken for post-mortem after a militant attack in Manipur, and a Naga organization issued a 48-hour… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Former BJP MLA Killed by Villagers Over Stone Crusher Dispute
item.description: Former Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MLA Bhadana was killed by villagers in Bharatpur, Rajasthan, following a dispute over the restarting of a stone crusher. The incident occurred due to a disagreement related to mining activities. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Melbourne Man Denies Links to Suspected Hijacker
item.description: A Melbourne man, identified as Samir Mohtadi and also known as Abu Hamza, who leads an Islamic centre allegedly linked to the accused Flydubai hijacker, has released a video. In the video, Mohtadi refers to Islamic texts on the virtues of… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Australian Engineer Robert Pether Allowed to Leave Iraq
item.description: Australian engineer Robert Pether has been permitted to leave Iraq after being jailed in 2021. The Australian foreign minister welcomed the Iraqi government's decision to allow his departure from Baghdad. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Houthis Attack Saudi Capital, Raising Regional War Concerns
item.description: The Houthi group launched attacks on Saudi Arabia's capital, Riyadh, targeting King Khalid International Airport. The Saudi-led coalition attributed these attacks to the Houthis. In response to the escalating conflict, several countries… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 10 · Right 4.

item.title: Houthi Missile Strike Kills 13 at Riyadh Airport, Including One Indian
item.description: A Houthi missile strike on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport on Saturday killed 13 people, including one Indian national and one person from Hyderabad. The attack, which injured 11 others, was captured on CCTV showing pilgrims… Coverage: Left 8 · Centre 21 · Right 3.

item.title: Five Dead in Apparent Murder-Suicide in Georgia
item.description: Five people were found dead in what is being investigated as a murder-suicide at a home in Georgia. The incident is being treated as an apparent murder-suicide. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Woman tried to stop man before tiger enclosure mauling
item.description: A woman reportedly attempted to prevent a man from entering a tiger enclosure at a zoo before he was mauled to death by a tiger. The incident occurred at the London Zoo. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Man Fatally Stabbed Outside Birmingham Pub Event
item.description: A man died after being stabbed outside a pub in Birmingham where a birthday party was taking place. The incident occurred in front of attendees of the event. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Australia United on Execution Ban, Clashes with Trump Over Streaming
item.description: Australia has united in its rejection of allowing the live-streaming of executions, a stance that has put the nation on a collision course with former US President Donald Trump. The debate over the morality and public display of executions… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Police pursuit ends in crash, one hospitalized
item.description: A police pursuit in Perth's southern suburbs concluded with a serious crash, resulting in one elderly man being rushed to the hospital. Another individual is in custody following the incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Abramovich Aides Accused of Falsifying Records to Hide Wealth
item.description: Aides of Russian billionaire Roman Abramovich, including staff at the accountancy firm Deloitte Cyprus, allegedly falsified paperwork to disguise his assets and potentially dodge tax, according to leaked records. The records suggest that… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Telangana Man Feared Dead on Russian Frontline; Family Seeks Answers
item.description: A man from Kamareddy, Telangana, is feared dead on the Russian frontline, according to reports. He is identified as Khan, and is among four men from Telangana who were allegedly misled into joining the Russian Army. His family is seeking… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Violence Erupts Amidst Protests, Authorities Respond
item.description: Violence broke out in Delhi on October 9 and 10, characterized by the use of lathis. The events occurred amidst protests, with reports describing an "eerie calm" following the violence. One outlet characterized the situation as "Violence… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Former MLA Atar Singh Bhadana killed in attack at crusher plant
item.description: Former MLA Atar Singh Bhadana was killed in an attack at a crusher plant in Bharatpur, Rajasthan. Reports indicate that 70-80 people attacked the plant. The incident is reportedly linked to a dispute over a mining lease with villagers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Delhi Police enters Bangla Sahib Gurudwara, detains protesters
item.description: Delhi Police entered the Bangla Sahib Gurudwara and detained protesters who had taken shelter there overnight. The Citzens for Justice and Peace (CJP) organization has urged "Sikh brothers" to join a fight against the government, alleging… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Court Denies UAPA-Accused Travel Abroad for UK Research
item.description: A Delhi court has denied UAPA-accused Natasha Narwal permission to travel to the UK for a research presentation at SOAS University. The Additional Sessions Judge at Karkardooma Courts cited that the right to travel abroad is not absolute… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Sixth POCSO Case Filed Against Granite Baron Veeramani
item.description: A sixth case under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act has been registered against Veeramani, identified as the chairman of Gem Granites and a granite baron. The case is related to a minor sexual abuse probe. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
